card.name: Technical documentation page structure and cross-references
card.fires_on: Separators and linking words in software or hardware manuals and knowledge-base pages, such as the pipe after a page title, or the word Section or see before a chapter number.

modes.label: Page title separator
modes.description: A pipe or space right after a documentation page heading or navigation bar, before the body text.

modes.label: Cross-reference wording
modes.description: The word Section, see, or this just before a chapter or section number in a manual.

card.plain: It fires on the layout and cross-reference words in technical manuals and help pages, not on medical content.
